clauses.scope_note: BSD-2-Clause; redistribution of the software in source form, with or without modification. The source-form notice duty is specified in lines 9–10.
clauses.condition_explanation: source_redistribution_conditions_met means retaining the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer in source-code redistributions.

obligation_items.content: Retain the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer in the source-code redistribution.
obligation_items.trigger: when redistributing the software in source-code form

clauses.scope_note: BSD-2-Clause; redistribution of the software in binary form, with or without modification. The binary-form notice duty is specified in lines 12–14.
clauses.condition_explanation: binary_redistribution_conditions_met means reproducing the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer in documentation and/or other materials provided with the binary distribution.

obligation_items.content: Reproduce the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer in the documentation and/or other materials provided with the binary distribution.
obligation_items.object: documentation and/or other materials provided with the binary distribution
obligation_items.trigger: when redistributing the software in binary form

clauses.scope_note: BSD-2-Clause; use of the software in source or binary form, with or without modification. The text makes redistribution subject to form-specific notice conditions; it does not state a separate notice duty for use without redistribution.
clauses.condition_explanation: The express permission covers use in source and binary forms, with or without modification. Redistribution conditions apply when the corresponding redistribution occurs.

clauses.scope_note: BSD-2-Clause; modification is included in the permission for use and redistribution with or without modification. Form-specific notice duties apply upon corresponding redistribution.
clauses.condition_explanation: The express permission covers activity with or without modification. Redistribution conditions apply when the corresponding source- or binary-form redistribution occurs.

clauses.scope_note: BSD-2-Clause, condition 1; source-code redistributions must retain the specified materials.
clauses.condition_explanation: source_notice_materials_retained means the source-code redistribution retains the above copyright notice, the list of conditions, and the disclaimer. The copyright line contains symbolic <year> and <owner> placeholders.

obligation_items.content: Retain the above copyright notice, the list of conditions, and the disclaimer.
obligation_items.trigger: when redistributing the software in source-code form

clauses.scope_note: BSD-2-Clause, condition 2; binary-form redistributions must reproduce the specified materials in accompanying documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
clauses.condition_explanation: binary_notice_materials_reproduced means reproducing the above copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer in the documentation and/or other materials provided with the binary distribution. The copyright line contains symbolic <year> and <owner> placeholders.

obligation_items.content: Reproduce the above copyright notice, the list of conditions, and the disclaimer in the documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
obligation_items.object: documentation and/or other materials provided with the binary distribution
obligation_items.trigger: when redistributing the software in binary form

coverage_notes: The copyright notice uses symbolic <year> and <owner> placeholders; no values are supplied.
Source-form and binary-form redistribution duties are distinct and apply only to their respective forms.
The warranty and liability disclaimer is not an activity constraint and is excluded.

paragraph_audit.reason: The license title identifies the document and is not an operative rule.
The copyright line supplies notice content, including symbolic placeholders, but does not independently state an activity constraint.
Expressly permits redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification; redistribution is subject to the applicable form-specific conditions.
Requires source-code redistributions to retain the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer.
Requires binary redistributions to reproduce the copyright notice, list of conditions, and disclaimer in documentation and/or other materials provided with the distribution.
Warranty and liability disclaimers do not create activity constraints for this extraction.
